chunks: And al-Ṣādiq, peace be upon him, said:
"The fire consumed what was in it."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام mean by "The fire consumed what was in it"?
ai.summary: This hadith states that fire consumes what is contained within the object exposed to it. In the chapter context of water, purity, and impurity, it serves as a concise legal indicator regarding the effect of burning on what is inside a thing.
